column2: I am the lord of angels, called the Great King of Heaven...
Give thanks to God that you were able to summon me!!
You fools are being deceived by appearances!!
does not matter to us demon lords!!
What matters is the banner of the $$教皇$$ who inherited Lord $$メフィスト$$'s remains!!
That banner alone is what matters!!
And merely being able to summon us...
doesn't that already make what is inside remarkable!?
Oh my! Somehow my stomach feels upset...
That $$サル$$ woman... Could she have eaten something she found on the ground!?
